title: Hotelogix Integrates Zoho Books: Automate Hotel Accounting #Shorts
description:
Automate hotel accounting by syncing Hotelogix with Zoho Books.

1. In Hotelogix settings, select Integrations and connect your Zoho Books account.
2. Map room revenue categories and local tax rates to corresponding Zoho Books ledger accounts.
3. Turn on automatic sync to push daily checkout folios and guest payments in real time.
